chunks.text:
Let's walk through the booking flow first and leave billing for later.
I shared the clinic list last Thursday, so you should have all 14 locations.
We want the portal to be mobile-first; most bookings come from phones.
I'll deliver the first wireframes by 2026-08-21.
I won't be taking on the patient survey, that's marketing's job.
One concern: the legacy scheduling system has no API, which is a risk for the integration.
I can design around that for now.

I sent the statement of work this morning, it should be in your inbox.
Got it. Decision: Larkspur signs the statement of work as written.
Who owns the data migration from the old scheduling system?
Let's take that offline; I don't have an answer yet.
Action: Tomas to set up the staging environment on Azure by 2026-08-28.

Our compliance team came back on hosting.
Decision: we move hosting to AWS instead of Azure, because the Microsoft agreement does not cover HIPAA workloads.
I'll redo the staging setup on AWS by 2026-09-04.
That pushes staging by a week but keeps the launch plan intact.

Alex's wireframes arrived on 2026-08-20 and the clinic managers liked them.
Staging on AWS has been up since Wednesday.
Decision: the portal launches with online booking and bill pay, and messaging waits for phase two.
I will finish the booking API integration by 2026-09-25.
I'll add SMS reminders if we ever get budget for Twilio.
Fine by me.

Thanks for making time. Today I want to agree on scope, hosting and next steps for the patient portal.
The portal needs to serve 14 clinics at launch, and patients should be able to book and pay online.
Decision: we host the portal on Azure because Larkspur already has a Microsoft agreement.
Good. I'll send the statement of work in two weeks.
Action: Priya to share the clinic list by 2026-08-07.
If the board rejects the budget, I'll pause the project until January.
Understood. For the record, the monthly retainer is 18,500 dollars.
Alex seemed worried about the board vote.
I'll ask Tomas whether the Azure credits cover staging.

The booking integration is done; I merged it yesterday.
Decision: the portal launches on 2026-10-05.
Action: Priya to train the front desk staff before launch.
I'm not going to build the analytics dashboard this phase.
